chapterTitle: Chapter 3 Organic Compounds: Alkanes and Their Stereochemistry
title: Problem 3-5

pages.text: PROBLEM 3-5 Propose structures that meet the following descriptions: (a) Two isomeric esters with the formula C5H10O2: (b) Two isomeric nitriles with the formula C4H7N (c) Two isomeric disulfides with the formula C4H10S2
